_comment: Every named place in Great Britain from the ONS Index of Place Names, LOC and BUA rows
only, one entry per distinct (name, district). Written by build-places.mjs beside this
file; do not hand-edit. `lads` is [code, name, county, country]; each place is
[name, index into lads, kind] where kind is a bit field: 1 = a 2022 Census built-up area,
2 = a named locality, 4 = a ward or division in that district is named for the place. It
orders several places of one name, built-up area first, then locality, then ward. Scotland and
Wales are here so the search can say "this is in Scotland" rather than nothing; only
England resolves to an authority, through lad-to-lta.json.
